risk_summary: The excerpt is generally transparent and quantitatively detailed, reporting year-over-year income, margins, expenses, capital-related judgments, and impairment testing. Risk is moderated by declining net interest margin, loan declines, COVID-19 effects, fair-value volatility, and uncertainty around credit-loss, pension, and technology-related expenses. Overall tone is cautiously positive, emphasizing profitability, capitalization, and operational soundness despite operating challenges.
